name: 陳育威
objective: This course is to instruct students the basic concepts of financial technology and to enable students to develop innovative applications of financial technology. The contents include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, P2P lending, virtual money, third-party payment, crowd funding, P2P remittance, blockchain, etc.
schedule:
1. Introduction to Fintech
2. Mobile payment
3. Crowd funding
4. P2P remittance
5. Blockchain
6. Embedded Finance
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



Reference book: Fintech revolution, Sofie Blakstad & Robert Allen (ebook)
延伸教學與資源:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
